output.summary: KEP-1020 proposed moving the pkg/kubectl code base into the Kubernetes staging directory (k8s.io/kubectl), incrementally, updating imports to the new k8s.io/kubectl paths. The KEP is now implemented and at stage stable per its status.
output.rationale: kubectl had grown dependencies on internal Kubernetes code, which made it tightly coupled and hard to maintain. Moving pkg/kubectl to staging is a necessary first step toward a separate kubectl repository, and staging code cannot depend on internal code, so the move proves and enforces decoupling. It also lets external projects reuse kubectl code.

alternatives.option: Move all of pkg/kubectl in a single step
alternatives.why_not: The readme says the code 'would not have to move all at once; it could be an incremental process.'

alternatives.option: Mark the KEP stable in 1.18 as the graduation comment suggested
alternatives.why_not: soltysh replied that 'it's still being worked on, it's a on-going process', so the work was not finished and the milestone moved to 1.19 and then 1.20.
